title: Who Should Have a Novice as Attendant
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.253 Numbered Discourses 5.253
  • 26. Upasampadāvagga 26. Ordination

Sāmaṇerasutta Who Should Have a Novice as Attendant

“Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo. “Mendicants, a novice should attend on a mendicant with five qualities. Katamehi pañcahi? What five? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti; asekhena samādhikkhandhena … asekhena paññākkhandhena … asekhena vimuttikkhandhena … asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti. It’s a mendicant who has the entire spectrum of an adept’s ethics, immersion, wisdom, freedom, and the knowledge and vision of freedom. Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo”ti. A novice should attend on a mendicant with these five qualities.”

Tatiyaṁ.
